{{Current events|year=2022|month=12|day=15|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Southern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Shell (projectile)|Shelling]] by [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] kills two people and leaves the entire city of [[Kherson]] without power. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-63983730 (BBC News)]
*[[2022 North Kosovo crisis]]
**[[Serbian President]] [[Aleksandar Vučić]] announces that the [[Serbian government]] will send a request to [[Kosovo Force|KFOR]] for the return of a certain number, "from hundreds to a thousand", of police and army personnel to [[Kosovo]], in accordance with [[UN Resolution 1244]]. [https://www.slobodnaevropa.org/a/vlada-srbije-kfor-zahtev/32178652.html (RFE/RL)]
*[[2017–present Peruvian political crisis]]
**[[December 2022 Peruvian protests]]
***[[Ayacucho massacre]]
****A massacre is perpetrated by the [[Peruvian Army]] in the city of [[Ayacucho]] following a crackdown in recent protests. The massacre killed 7 and wounded 52. [https://rpp.pe/peru/actualidad/ayacucho-diresa-confirma-un-muerto-y-10-heridos-por-enfrentamientos-noticia-1453926 (RPP)]
'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–present United Kingdom cost of living crisis]]
**The [[Royal College of Nursing]] begins the largest [[strike action]] in the history of the [[National Health Service]] amid a dispute with the [[government of the United Kingdom|government]] over a pay increase for [[nursing|nurses]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/health-63946730 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pennsylvania]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Philadelphia]]
*****The [[School District of Philadelphia]] will require students to wear [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United  States|face masks]] for 10 days after the winter break amidst a spike in [[COVID-19]] cases. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/philadelphia-schools-will-require-masks-us-covid-cases-spike-2022-12-15/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
****The [[United States Senate]] passes a [[James M. Inhofe National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2023|defense bill]] that rescinds the [[COVID-19 vaccination mandates in the United States#Federal vaccine mandates|vaccine mandate]] for the [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]]. [https://www.latimes.com/politics/story/2022-12-15/senate-passes-defense-bill-rescinding-covid-vaccine-mandate?_amp=true (''Los Angeles Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Accession of Bosnia and Herzegovina to the European Union]]
**The [[European Council]] formally grants [[Enlargement of the European Union|candidate status]] to [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. [https://sarajevotimes.com/huge-historic-move-eu-grants-bosnia-and-herzegovina-candidate-status/ (''Sarajevo Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Assassination of John F. Kennedy]]
**The [[Presidency of Joe Biden|Biden administration]] orders the release of thousands of documents on the assassination of former [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[John F. Kennedy]] for the first time. With 13,173 files now published online, more than 97% of records are now publicly available, according to the [[White House]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-63994729 (BBC News)]
*Police in [[Zambia]] arrest a truck driver alleged to have transported 27 [[Ethiopians|Ethiopian]] migrants who were found dead at a farm on the outskirts of [[Lusaka]] on Sunday. [https://english.news.cn/20221215/0c1ab260b5c64071b0a658ee853b73e6/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Political status of Puerto Rico]]
**In a 233–191 bipartisan vote, the [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. House of Representatives]] passes a bill that would allow [[Puerto Rico]] to have its first ever binding referendum to decide whether the [[Territories of the United States|unincorporated territory]] should become a [[U.S. state|state]], an [[Sovereign state|independent nation]] or an [[Associated state|independent nation with free association]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/12/15/us/politics/house-puerto-rican-statehood.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Acquisition of Twitter by Elon Musk]]
**[[Thursday Night Massacre]]
***[[Twitter]] [[Twitter suspensions|suspends]] the accounts of several journalists who reported on negative news relating to [[Elon Musk]] and Twitter.  Musk accuses these journalists of posting links to real-time location data.  The suspensions come following an incident in Los Angeles involving the safety of [[Elon Musk]]'s son.  [https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2022/dec/15/twitter-suspends-accounts-journalists-musk (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2022/12/16/twitter-ardently-suspends-journalists-who-cover-elon-musk (''Al Jazeera'')],[https://news.yahoo.com/twitter-bans-came-musks-claim-061937023.html (''Yahoo'')]
